boundary.host_graphics: Host GLES executes the extracted shader strings from pinned Pencil3 DSO with masks read from that DSO; GLES context, target, transforms, color, blend and paper phase are host configured.
boundary.native_geometry_source: pencil3-sampler-inputs-native.json; native callback stream words were captured after actual selected GLV3 redraw and actual RTV1 AddPoint callback path
boundary.native_phase_join: Saved redraw stream hash/count and byte equality with Drawing stream plus same RT identity are checked before reusing captured Drawing words for the saved-phase host replay.
not_claimed: native app projection or paper phase

host_assumptions.paper_coordinate_phase: embedded shader vCanvasUV=(clip.xy/clip.w+1)/2 on the synthetic centered target; paper samples vCanvasUV*uPaperScale with repeat
host_assumptions.projection: synthetic centered projection; logical units per pixel = 1/scale; matrix diagonal is 2*scale/128
host_assumptions.target_origin: bottom-left in stored GL readback bytes
host_assumptions.white_paper_control: A 150x150 red=255 texture is substituted; all geometry, shader, projection and blend settings remain the same.

scope: Captured native Model/Drawing V3 source arrays, saved redraw sampler, private RNG and RTV1 AddPoint packed streams from the pinned five-case sampler fixture are replayed as instanced attributes through the pinned Pencil3 embedded shader and mask bytes on host Mesa GLES. Saved phase reuses the draw stream only after native fixture's full-byte-equality and same-RT assertions. This runner does not re-execute the native sampler, Model or Drawing; no native V3 Draw, native FBO, Android GLES, document PDF, or production Renderer is executed.
